method: Visual inspection of 145 timestamped frames at 0.5-second intervals spanning the entire 72.443-second original recording, plus physical touch/lifecycle logs and device-owner confirmation. Contact sheets are review derivatives; original MP4 remains unchanged. This is not every-frame or performance certification.

observations.result: App reappears with intact PBR cube; horizontal and vertical perspective changes follow.
New rotation and system home gesture; full canvas remains correctly proportioned.
Recovery followed by camera movement through side/top/bottom perspectives and another home gesture.
Recovery, rotation, then stable pose at approximately 42.5-44 seconds before leaving; consistent with up at 18:31:22.292 and unchanged camera through 18:31:24.426 cancel.
Recovery followed by repeated camera changes with visible PBR highlight; poses remain stable between motions.
Final visible recovery and renewed rotation; no persistent black screen or stuck input observed.

logCorrelation.note: Screen clock, ordered frame labels and camera states agree with the same host session. No exact per-frame wall-clock synchronization is claimed.

acceptance.A05: pass: continuous recording plus physical camera/transform samples and owner confirmation
acceptance.A06: pass: primary-release/held-secondary log samples plus owner confirmation; finger count is not directly visible in screen recording
acceptance.A07: pass: system home gestures, native cancellation samples and subsequent drags
acceptance.A08: pass: earlier six qualifying cycles plus four further qualifying cycles; loops/input clean and presentation/drag resume

limitations: Screen recording contains no visible finger markers; native event records establish touch identity.
Two recording-phase background intervals are below 5000 ms and are excluded.
This recording is functional evidence, not G05 performance or long-term memory evidence.
